about: Spec.InferSold(base, current, dt, bandMin, own) -> sold, partial (contract C6, revision 2). base = the same character's previous full scan of one item: price levels ascending [[unitPrice, [[band, count], ...]], ...], each auction as [band 0..3 after the offset, units], in the order the scan read them (at most the 40 cheapest levels and 200 auctions, whole levels only); current = this scan's auctions of the item per unit price ({"price": [[band, count], ...]}, JSON keys are prices as text, at least every price up to the highest base price); dt = seconds between the two scans (905..7200); bandMin = minimum seconds left per band (default [0, 1800, 7200, 43200], read at runtime from C_AuctionHouse.GetTimeLeftBandInfo); own = units the scanning account bought of this item in (base.t, t] (COMMODITY_PURCHASED / ITEM_PURCHASED log). Own listings are excluded from both scans before this runs. Rule: pool = units of current auctions cheaper than the cheapest base level. For each base level, cheapest first: (1) match each old auction, in order, to an unused current auction at that price with the same count and band <= the old band (prefer the highest band, then the first index): unchanged; (2) the old auctions still unmatched, by count descending (stable), take the unused current auction with the largest count below theirs and band <= theirs (ties: higher band, then first index): partial buy of old - new units (auctions are cancelled whole, so this is a purchase); (3) unused current auctions at that price add their units to pool; (4) if the level had no partial buy and no vanished auction, stop; (5) add the partial units; each vanished old auction whose band minimum >= dt (it could not have expired) counts its units minus repost = min(units, pool), and pool decreases by repost (vanished auctions with an unsafe band neither count nor use the pool); (6) stop after a level where an old auction survived (matched in 1 or 2). sold = max(0, partial + counted - own). It is an estimate, not a minimum: a cheapest auction withdrawn without a repost counts as sold; sales hidden by reposts or new units at the same or a lower price, and sales of auctions posted between the two scans, are not seen.

cases.note: nothing changed
partial buy at the cheapest level: sure units, stop there
cheapest level gone, next partly bought
cheapest intact: a loss above it is not a sale (cancelled)
short band could have expired: not counted, the walk goes on
medium band is safe up to dt 1800
medium band not safe at dt 2700
medium band safe at dt 905 (baseline from a refresh-only scan)
long band safe up to 7200
a new listing at the same price is not a sale
vanished and the same units reappear at the same price: repost, not counted
mixed bands on one level: only safe vanished auctions count
every level gone
empty baseline
undercut war: X cancels 20 at 100 and reposts at 98 under Y's 10 at 99: no sale
partly bought, the rest reposted cheaper: only the bought part counts
a partial buy counts even with new cheaper units
own purchases are subtracted
own purchases larger than the estimate: 0
the band may drop between scans: same auction
the band cannot rise: a new 24 h auction, the old one vanished and its units reappeared (repost)
two partial buys: each old auction takes the largest smaller survivor
new cheaper units are used up by the first vanished auctions
unsafe vanished auctions do not use the repost pool
